title: bee orient escalates capture-queue from offer to blocker past thresholds
action: In bee orient (status_full/orient.rs): when pending capture stubs >= 10 OR the oldest pending stub is older than 7 days, the capture-queue line moves from offer to the blockers array. Pending = stub rows without a matching flush row. Constants in code (D2). Red-first per D6. Tests: boundary 9 vs 10 stubs, age boundary, flushed stubs never count.

truths: pending-count computation test green (stub minus flush)
boundary tests at 10 stubs and 7 days
blocker line appears in orient blockers
